games.name: Izvēlies pareizo atbildi
games.notes: 3–4 options. REQUIRED: correct_answer (0-based index), explanation. One clear factual/Gospel answer.

games.name: Patiess vai nepatiess
games.notes: options: ["Patiess", "Nepatiess"]. REQUIRED: correct_answer (0 or 1), explanation. Avoid trick questions that undermine faith.

games.name: Aizpildi tukšo vietu
games.notes: REQUIRED: answer (string), explanation. One meaningful blank from the reading or main idea.

games.name: Sajaukti burti
games.notes: REQUIRED: scrambled, answer, explanation. Scramble an important word from today’s reading. explanation must be neutral (no „Lieliski!” / „Pareizi!” — UI adds that).

games.name: Kas es esmu?
games.notes: REQUIRED: answer, explanation. Clues about a person from the Scripture.

games.name: Sakārto notikumus
games.notes: REQUIRED: items (scrambled order for UI), correct_answer as ordered string array OR explanation of correct order, explanation. 3–5 events.

games.name: Sasaisti pārus
games.notes: REQUIRED: pairs [{left, right}], short explanation. Pairs shown already matched for younger UX; 3–4 pairs.

games.name: Ko tu darītu?
games.notes: Everyday situation linked to Gospel. 2–3 respectful options. REQUIRED: correct_answer = index of Gospel-aligned preferred option; explanation = warm 1–3 sentences (why this path fits today’s Word). Do NOT shame other options; frame as growth, not failure. UI will not say „nepareizi”.

games.name: Atrodi kļūdu
games.notes: A short retelling with one incorrect detail as options or in the prompt. REQUIRED: correct_answer, explanation.

games.name: Labākā atbilde
games.notes: Choose the response that best reflects the Scripture’s teaching. Same fields as scenario_choice: correct_answer + warm explanation; gentle preference, not harsh wrong.
